overview.text: Today's key developments span agent evolution, novel model representations, streaming video-language models, and hardware infrastructure updates. First, RSIHub provides a composable framework for agent-evolution methods, helping researchers avoid rebuilding experimental machinery. Second, TWIG introduces tree-structured weights with inherited gates, representing neural network weights as paths of discrete decisions. Third, DirCast tackles live esports directing and commentary using a single streaming video-language model to handle unpredictable real-time broadcasts. Fourth, DraMaze implements a multi-agent pipeline with future-aware memory for microdrama script generation. Finally, analysis on Amazon's Trainium explores its expanding capabilities for model training alongside inference. Together, these releases and research papers offer new tools and paradigms for engineers and founders navigating architecture design, agent orchestration, and efficient hardware deployment.

entries.title: RSIHub: A Composable Framework for Agent-Evolution Methods
entries.summary: Agent-evolution methods use execution feedback to improve prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration, but their implementations often rebuild the same experimental machinery.
entries.why: Provides a composable framework that standardizes agent-evolution implementations and avoids redundant experimental machinery.

entries.title: Every Weight Is a Path of Shared Discrete Decisions
entries.summary: We introduce TWIG (Tree-structured Weights with Inherited Gates), a representation in which every weight of a neural network is the end of a path of small discrete decisions: a sign, a shift by a power of two, a zero gate, an index into a shared table.
entries.why: Represents neural network weights as paths of small discrete decisions to alter underlying architecture structures.

entries.title: DirCast: Live Esports Directing and Commentary with a Single Streaming Video-Language Model
entries.summary: A live esports broadcast needs a director who chooses which camera goes on air and a caster who talks over that choice, every second and without knowing what comes next.
entries.why: Directs and comments on live esports broadcasts in real time using a single streaming video-language model.

entries.title: DraMaze: A Multi-Agent Pipeline with Future-Aware Memory for Diverse Microdrama Script Generation
entries.summary: The rapid growth of microdramas has increased demand for high-quality script production. Long-form microdrama script generation with LLMs requires both diverse plot progression and long-range narrative coherence.
entries.why: Combines a multi-agent pipeline and future-aware memory to generate coherent long-form microdrama scripts.

entries.title: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
entries.summary: On-policy self-distillation enables post-training foundation models without relying on stronger external teachers. However, existing approaches rely on ground-truth question-answer pairs, human-curated problem sets, or other supervised signals.
entries.why: Enables data-free self-improvement in foundation models via on-policy self-distillation without external teacher dependencies.

entries.title: Easy-3Dfy: Object-Level Geometric Composition for Single-Image 3D Scene Construction
entries.summary: Single-image 3D scene construction is a fundamental problem in 3D vision. Recent methods such as SAM-3Dfy enable end-to-end reconstruction of 3D assets and their scene layouts, but still struggle with fine-grained scene geometry and asset quality.
entries.why: Aims to improve fine-grained scene geometry and asset quality in single-image 3D scene construction.

entries.title: LoCA: Enabling Multi-Modality in Geospatial Location Encoders
entries.summary: Location encoders map geographic coordinates to high-dimensional descriptors through contrastive alignment with paired Earth Observation imagery.
entries.why: Enables multi-modality in geospatial location encoders using contrastive alignment with Earth Observation imagery.

entries.title: Cattmonkey/ChaosIntelligence
entries.summary: 把智能体当函数，把想法写成程序。Agent-native functional language with a CLI, Web IDE, goal-driven bots and live UI. Source-available; no AI training. · Python
entries.why: Offers an agent-native functional language with a CLI, Web IDE, goal-driven bots, and live UI.

entries.summary: DSH 破甲插件：token 级重试环 + 十片按需叶子（含邻近交付）+ 分级 prefill + 拒答阶梯 L0–L3 + finish_reason 四路分流 + 请求体级整形。零宿主补丁，188 项测试 / 56 条探针。 · JavaScript

entries.title: ChinAI #379: “Chinese AI only makes trash TV?”
entries.why: Explores commentary surrounding Chinese AI television content production and cultural perceptions.

entries.title: Seam Cutter
entries.summary: Tool: Seam Cutter I built this weird and very specific cropping tool - it lets you create a horizontal or vertical cut across an image, then slide the two sides relative to each other. Effectively it lets you crop out a section in the middle of an image.
entries.why: Offers a specific cropping utility allowing users to slide image sides relative to a horizontal or vertical cut.

entries.title: Amazon’s Trainium Takes a Strike at the Training King
entries.summary: Trainium Best for Inference? But now good for Training too, Native Trainium PyTorch, High Quality CI, TorchTitan, GPU Impossible Profiler
entries.why: Examines Amazon Trainium expanding its capabilities from inference to high-performance model training.
